opus.problem: The accepted answer "lot" is also the name of Abraham's nephew Lot, a well-known Bible person. A baker guessing the person Lot would be marked correct, so the answer does not point to only one thing.

Several details are not in the cited verse Acts 1:26: Judas being gone, the apostles praying, and Joseph called Barsabbas. They come from Acts 1:23-25, so the clue is not fully backed by its reference.
The cited verse John 19:24 does not say the tunic was seamless. That detail is from John 19:23, so the clue is not fully backed by its reference.
